events.text: The western passes are clear of snow. The first caravans of the year set out.

choices.text: Travel with a caravan for a week

effects.log: Camels, spices and stories from a hundred cities.
A small profit on silk. (+8 taels)

events.text: A fighter from beyond the western desert demonstrates a strange curved-sword style.

effects.log: Circles instead of lines. It opens your mind.

ok.log: A draw, and a new friend from far away.

events.text: Desert raiders attack caravans at the oasis wells.

ok.log: The raiders ride off. The caravan master pays you well. (+15 taels)

effects.log: A longer road, but no blood.

events.text: A western physician sells medicines nobody here has seen.

choices.text: Buy a jar of healing salve

effects.log: It actually works. (−5 taels)
He learns acupuncture; you learn about strange herbs.

events.text: A foreign merchant is being cheated because he cannot speak the language.

effects.log: Fair prices, and a friend who sends you gifts from the west.
He learns fast. Nobody cheats him again.

events.text: A troupe of western dancers performs in the oasis town.

effects.log: Spinning skirts and bells. Their balance is a martial art.
You spin once and fall over. They cheer.

events.text: A western merchant lost his caravan in a sandstorm and wandered into town half-dead.

effects.log: He gives you a curved dagger in thanks.
Two days of searching. Found.

events.text: Traders sell glass beads more colourful than any jade.

effects.log: They wear it every day. (−3 taels)
Glass from a land you will never see.

events.text: A caravan brings a strange animal to the village: a creature with two humps.

effects.log: It is taller than a house. You scream the whole time.
It eats your hat.

events.text: Ruins of an ancient caravanserai buried in the sand.

ok.log: Old coins from a kingdom that no longer exists. (+12 taels)

choices.text: Rest in the shade of the old walls

effects.log: Travellers have rested here for a thousand years.

events.text: A western storyteller tells of a hero who fought a lion with his bare hands.

effects.log: You tell of the Heavenly Demon. He is terrified.

choices.text: Listen until the stars come out

effects.log: The world is enormous.

events.text: A caravan you met this spring heads west. They ask if you will come.

effects.log: Your road is here.

choices.text: Walk with them to the last town

effects.log: A long goodbye, and gifts.
